To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the design of a phased array antenna module for 28 GHz 5G base stations requires careful attention to the design of the RFIC and the packaging to ensure high performance and that a 60 GHz switched-beam transceiver module for 5G user equipment requires careful design of the RF front end, the antenna, and the package to enable a compact and low cost design.
we have developed mmWave modules that are critical for 5G wireless communication.
(a) the 28 GHz phased arrays have been successfully integrated into a module with 64 antennas and a compact 4×4 phased array with integrated beam forming and beam steering has been demonstrated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and development of millimeter-wave antennas and transceiver modules, with an emphasis on 5G and other emerging applications.
the design and implementation of antenna modules and packaging for 5G wireless communication.
the design, implementation, and measurement of millimeter wave (mmWave) phased array antennas and transceiver modules for 5G wireless applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the antenna in package (AiP) design and module integration is an important enabling technology for mmWave and 5G applications.

mmWave antenna in package design is a critical component in the development of 5G communication systems and that the design and implementation of mmWave antennas in packages is a critical enabling technology.
the design of the antenna module is critical to the overall performance of the 5G system and must be considered at the earliest stages of the system design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mmWave antenna modules are feasible for commercial deployment in 5G applications.
we have demonstrated the feasibility and benefits of integrating mmWave antenna modules into the package of the RFIC.

the mmWave phased array modules are very challenging to design due to the need to integrate multiple functions into the same package, the need to achieve low cost, and the need to maintain high performance in the presence of high loss and high parasitics in the package and interconnects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
antenna in package design and system level integration are key enablers to the realization of 5G wireless communication systems.

the design and integration of antennas and modules for 5G applications requires a close collaboration between RFIC, package design, and antenna design engineers to ensure a high level of integration and performance.
mmWave antenna modules can be designed and integrated into a package to meet the challenging 5G requirements.
